definitions.explanation: Having the same quality, quantity, or condition throughout. No variation or unevenness.
A single fixed price for all items or services. Commonly seen in shops where everything costs the same amount.

examples.japanese: ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{均一|きんいつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧。
⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{均一|きんいつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦かき{混|ま}ぜる→かき混ぜる：15739_kakimazeru⟧。
examples.english: Stir well so that the temperature becomes uniform.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{厚|あつ}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{均一|きんいつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's hard to make the dough thickness uniform.

examples.english: I bought it at a 100-yen flat-rate shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運賃|うんちん}→運賃：05299_unchin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{均一|きんいつ}⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧だ。
examples.english: The bus fare is a flat rate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{千円|せんえん}→千円：08980_senen⟧{均一|きんいつ}⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}している→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧。
examples.english: They are holding a 1,000-yen flat-rate sale.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 2 is particularly common in daily life. {百円|ひゃくえん}{均一|きんいつ} (100-yen shops) are ubiquitous in Japan — the word is often shortened to {百均|ひゃっきん} in casual speech. Many city buses also charge {均一|きんいつ}⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧ (flat-rate fares).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {百円|ひゃくえん}{均一|きんいつ}: 100-yen flat rate (100-yen shop)
- {均一|きんいつ}⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: flat-rate charge
- {均一|きんいつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧: to keep uniform
- ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{均一|きんいつ}: uniform quality
